Outreach.title: Outreach
Outreach.description: Represents an outreach event organized by a coordinator.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Outreach entity.

location.description: Location where the outreach event takes place.

participantIds.description: References to Users (Reachers). (Relationship: User N:N Outreach)

newConvertIds.description: References to NewConvert objects (Relationship: Outreach 1:N NewConvert)

status.description: Status of the outreach event (planned, ongoing, completed).

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the outreach event was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the outreach event was last updated.

NewConvert.title: NewConvert
NewConvert.description: Represents a new believer encountered during an outreach event.

id.description: Unique identifier for the NewConvert entity.

phone.description: Phone number of the new convert.

status.description: Status of the new convert (e.g., just met, follow-up scheduled).

notes.description: Additional notes about the new convert.

assignedTo.description: Reference to User (Reacher) assigned to follow up with the new convert. (Relationship: User 1:N NewConvert)

definition.description: Represents outreach events. Includes denormalized 'participantIds' and 'coordinatorId' for authorization.

params.name: outreachId
params.description: The unique ID of the outreach event.

definition.description: Represents new converts associated with a specific outreach event. Includes denormalized 'outreachId' and `assignedTo` for authorization.

params.name: outreachId
params.description: The ID of the outreach event to which the new convert belongs.

params.name: newConvertId
params.description: The unique ID of the new convert.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore data structure is designed to support the Outreach feature, focusing on authorization independence, clarity, and scalability. It leverages denormalization to avoid complex security rules that require `get()` calls. 

`outreaches/{outreachId}`:
This path stores outreach events. The `coordinatorId` and `participantIds` are stored directly in the document to allow for security rules to check for ownership and participation without extra database reads. 

`outreaches/{outreachId}/new_converts/{newConvertId}`:
This structure enables each outreach event to manage its new converts. The `new_converts` subcollection is designed to store contact information and follow-up notes for each new convert. The `outreachId` is denormalized within each `new_converts` document to enforce the relationship. The `assignedTo` field within the `new_converts` documents stores the `userId` of the reacher assigned to follow up with the new convert.
